cw_cheats_engine_off: The cheat engine is off. Switching a cheat on starts it.
cw_cheats_err_busy: Another app is changing this game's cheats right now. Try again in a moment.
cw_cheats_err_changed: The cheat files changed. The list was read again.
cw_cheats_err_load: Could not read the cheats ({code}). Press Refresh to try again.
cw_cheats_err_module: This cheat needs a part of the game that has not loaded yet. Try again later in the game.
cw_cheats_exited_next: Start it again and its cheats come back here.
cw_cheats_find_err_store: Could not save {name} on the console ({code}).
cw_cheats_find_hint: Cheats are made for one game version. Pick the one that matches yours.
cw_cheats_find_how: ✕ downloads the focused file to the console.
cw_cheats_find_no_match: Nothing for version {v} yet. These are for other versions: they usually do nothing, and can crash the game.
cw_cheats_find_none: Nobody has published cheats for this game yet.
cw_cheats_find_offline: This PS5 can't reach GitHub. Get cheats in the PS5Upload app on your PC, or allow raw.githubusercontent.com in your DNS settings.
cw_cheats_find_partial: Some cheat sources could not be reached, so the list may be incomplete.
cw_cheats_find_replaced: {name} was replaced on the console. Its cheats are in the list now.
cw_cheats_find_saved: {name} is on the console. Its cheats are in the list now.
cw_cheats_find_too_large: {name} is too large for a cheat file.
cw_cheats_how: ✕ or □ switches the focused cheat on or off.
cw_cheats_no_game_next: Start a game, then open Cheats.
cw_cheats_none: No cheats for this game yet.
cw_cheats_none_next: Find cheats for it online, or add them from the PS5Upload app on your PC.
cw_cheats_truncated: Not every cheat fits here. The PS5Upload app on your PC shows them all.
cw_ctl_logging: While this screen is open, button presses are saved to a small log on this console to improve controller support.
cw_ctl_press_each: Press each button once to see what this page receives. ○ closes this screen, so press it last.
cw_error_body: The page hit an error and stopped. Reload it, or reset the page's settings (theme, language, view) and reload.
cw_fan_err_above: That is warmer than this console's own setting, so it was not applied.
cw_fan_err_load: The fan could not be read.
cw_fan_err_set: The fan setting could not be changed.
cw_fan_explain: Lower = fans spin up sooner and louder. PS5Upload keeps your choice when a game starts.
cw_fan_failing: PS5Upload could not keep your choice, so the console's own fan control is in charge. Choose again to retry.
cw_fan_restart_note: PS5Upload no longer sets the fan. The console's own setting returns when a game starts or closes, or at the next restart.
cw_fan_restored_min: Restored after a game reset it — {n} min ago
cw_fan_restored_s: Restored after a game reset it — {n} s ago
cw_files_br_err_exists: “{name}” is already used in this folder.
cw_files_br_err_long: “{name}” would get a name longer than 255 bytes.
cw_files_br_err_slash: “{name}” would get a name with “/” in it.
cw_files_br_err_twice: Two items would both be named “{name}”.
cw_files_br_err_unchanged: “{name}” would not change. Every name must change.
cw_files_br_failed: “{from}” could not be renamed to “{to}”: {reason} Renamed {done}; {rest} not tried.
cw_files_br_prefix: Text to add at the start
cw_files_br_suffix: Text to add at the end
cw_files_br_template_hint: {n} is replaced by the number. Leave it empty to keep each name and add the number. The extension is kept.
cw_files_br_waiting: Type the text to see the new names.
cw_files_capped: Showing the first {n} items; this folder has more.
cw_files_conflict_body: Skip it, keep both (the pasted one gets a new name), or replace the one already here.
cw_files_conflict_body_self: This is the item itself. Skip it, or keep both (the copy gets a new name).
cw_files_conflict_replace_all_body: Files already here are overwritten; folders, and everything in them, are deleted first. This can't be undone.
cw_files_conflict_replace_dir_body: What is already here, and everything in it, is deleted first. This can't be undone.
cw_files_conflict_replace_file_body: The file already here is overwritten. This can't be undone.
cw_files_del_body: Folders are deleted with everything in them. This can't be undone.
cw_files_download_started: Downloading {name}. Your browser shows the progress.
cw_files_edit_binary: The text has a NUL byte, so it cannot be saved as text.
cw_files_edit_changed: This file changed on the console after you opened it. Saving now replaces that change.
cw_files_edit_eol_note: Some line breaks in this file are a lone CR (old Mac style). Saving turns them into the file's usual line breaks.
cw_files_edit_gone: The file is not there any more.
cw_files_edit_not_text: This file is not UTF-8 text, so it cannot be edited here.
cw_files_edit_too_large: Files over 1 MiB cannot be edited here.
cw_files_eject_blocked_batch: Files is still copying, moving or deleting on this drive. Eject it when that is done.
cw_files_eject_blocked_jobs: A transfer is running. Eject the drive after it finishes.
cw_files_eject_body: The drive is unmounted so you can unplug it. First close any game or app that is reading from or writing to it.
cw_files_eject_busy: The drive is still in use.
cw_files_eject_done: {path} ejected. You can unplug the drive.
cw_files_eject_force_body: The PS5 keeps the drive open; its own services usually do. Ejecting anyway saves everything to the drive first, so it is safe as long as no game or app is reading from or writing to it right now.
cw_files_eject_force_title: {path} is still in use. Eject anyway?
cw_files_eject_gone: That drive is no longer connected.
cw_files_empty_next: Copy files here from the PS5Upload app on your PC, or make a new folder.
cw_files_err_denied: The console doesn't allow changes here.
cw_files_err_exists: Something with that name is already there.
cw_files_err_into_itself: A folder can't go into itself or one of its folders.
cw_files_fixperm_body: Makes everything in this folder readable and runnable by the PS5 (chmod 777). Use it when a game won't start after copying.
cw_files_from_pc_gone: Your PC sent {path}, but it isn't on the console any more.
cw_files_goto_bad: Type a full path that starts with /.
cw_files_goto_missing: There is no folder at that path.
cw_files_goto_not_folder: That is a file, not a folder.
cw_files_last_gone: The folder you had open last ({path}) is gone.
cw_files_no_folders_next: Choose Here to use this folder.
cw_files_op_gone: The console no longer has this task, so its result is not known.
cw_files_paste_halted: Stopped. “{name}” was not pasted; the item it was replacing is still being deleted.
cw_files_perm_not_kept: This drive ({fs}) does not keep permissions: every file there shows the same ones, and a change made here does not last.
cw_files_pin_full: No room for more pinned folders. Unpin one first.
cw_files_replace_failed: Couldn't delete the item being replaced, so it was not pasted.
cw_files_search_bad: Quotes and backslashes cannot be searched for.
cw_files_search_building: Building the index… {n} files so far.
cw_files_search_capped: It is full (200,000 files), so some files are missing.
cw_files_search_hint: Finds files by name. A word matches anywhere in the name; use * and ? for a pattern (*.pkg).
cw_files_search_more: Showing the first {n}. There are more: try a longer name.
cw_files_search_no_index: No index yet. The first search builds one: it reads every folder and can take a few minutes.
cw_files_search_none_capped: Too many files elsewhere match, so none in this folder came back. Use a longer name, or Build again to index this folder only.
cw_files_search_partial: It was stopped early, so some files are missing.
cw_files_search_unsupported: PS5Upload on this console is too old to search. Update it to use search.
cw_files_search_waiting: Searches for “{q}” when the index is ready.
cw_files_show_pc_failed: Couldn't send it to the PC.
cw_files_size_busy: Another folder size is being calculated. Try again when it has finished.
cw_files_size_cancelled: Cancelled: the total is only part of the folder.
cw_files_size_capped: Stopped at {n} items: the folder holds more, so the total is only part of it.
cw_files_size_timeout: Stopped after {s} seconds: the total is only part of the folder.
cw_files_unmount_body: A game running from this image will stop, and its files are gone until the image is mounted again.
cw_files_unmount_busy: The image is in use. Close the game that uses it first.
cw_files_unmount_not_ours: Only images that PS5Upload mounted can be unmounted here.
cw_files_unmount_system: The console's own storage can't be unmounted.
cw_files_unpack_body: Writes “{name}” ({size}) next to it. The .ffpfsc file is kept.
cw_files_unpack_busy: Another decompress is running on the console.
cw_files_unpack_exists: “{name}” is already here. Choose Keep both to write it under another name.
cw_files_unpack_free_unknown: The free space here could not be read; the console checks it again before it starts.
cw_files_unpack_generic: The size could not be checked first. It needs free space for the whole image plus 1 GiB; the console refuses to start without it.
cw_files_unpack_no_space: Not enough free space: it needs {need} (the image plus 1 GiB), and {free} is free.
cw_files_unpack_no_space_short: Not enough free space on that drive.
cw_files_unpack_not_container: This is not a .ffpfsc the console can read.
cw_files_unpack_not_image: The image inside is not an exFAT image, so it isn't supported.
cw_files_unpack_wait_batch: Another task is running. Decompress can start when it has finished.
cw_files_up_hint: Files are sent one at a time, and each one appears only once it is complete.
cw_files_usage_busy: Another folder size is being measured. Try again when it ends.
cw_files_usage_cancelled: Cancelled: {size} counted, the rest was not measured.
cw_files_usage_capped: Stopped at {items} items: {size} counted, the folder holds more.
cw_files_usage_timeout: Stopped after 3 minutes: {size} counted, the rest was not measured.
cw_files_verify_failed: The checksum could not be calculated.
cw_files_verify_not_file: Only a file can be verified.
cw_files_vw_json_raw: This JSON could not be read, so it is shown as written.
cw_games_confirm_uninstall_pkg: This removes the game from the PS5. You can install it again later from its package.
cw_games_confirm_uninstall_registered: This takes the game off the home screen. Its folder or disk image stays where it is.
cw_games_err_launch_refused: The console refused to start it. Homebrew and fake-package games need kstuff running; a disk-image game also needs ShadowMount+.
cw_games_err_other_running: Another game is running. Close it first.
cw_games_err_running: Close the game before you uninstall it.
cw_games_err_uninstall_refused: The PS5 refused to uninstall it ({code}).
cw_games_err_uninstall_unavailable: This console cannot uninstall from here. Use Settings → Storage on the PS5.
cw_games_hidden_done: {name}: home-screen icon hidden. The home screen updates after you open and close any app.
cw_games_incomplete: The console did not list everything: some games may be missing.
cw_games_launch_slow: {name} has not shown up yet. The console may still be starting it: give it a moment.
cw_games_none_hidden: No game has its icon hidden.
cw_games_note_other_running: Another game is running. Close it first to start this one.
cw_games_removing_note: The PS5 is removing {name}. A big game can take a few minutes.
cw_games_shown_done: {name}: home-screen icon shown again. The home screen updates after you open and close any app.
cw_games_still_present: {name} is still on the console. If it stays, delete it in the PS5's Settings → Storage.
cw_help_pointer: Left stick moves the PS5 pointer; ✕ clicks what it is over.
cw_help_unconfirmed: Not confirmed on this PS5 yet:
cw_home_confirm_cancel_body: It stops now. This cannot be undone.
cw_home_confirm_cancel_body_pc: A PC started this task. It stops on the PC too.
cw_home_confirm_close_body: Progress you have not saved in the game is lost.
cw_home_err_busy: The console is busy. Try again in a moment.
cw_home_err_load_tasks: Could not read the task list.
cw_home_err_offline: The console did not answer. Try again.
cw_home_leave_hint: To go back to the PS5 home screen, press the PS button.
cw_home_no_game_next: Start a game from the PS5 home screen; its cheats appear here.
cw_home_no_game_plain: Start a game from the PS5 home screen.
cw_home_no_tasks_next: Uploads from the PS5Upload app on your PC show up here.
cw_offline_body: Load the PS5Upload helper from the PS5Upload app on your PC or from your payload loader. This page opens by itself once the helper answers.
cw_phone_body: Scan the code or open this address on a phone or PC on the same network, and type there.
cw_phone_qr_label: QR code of this page's address
cw_procs_confirm_game_body: The game is force-closed. Progress you have not saved is lost.
cw_procs_confirm_payload_body: What it provides (kstuff, etaHEN and the like) stops until you load it again, and games that need it may not start.
cw_procs_err_protected: That process cannot be stopped from here.
cw_procs_intro: What runs on the PS5 now. You can stop a game or a payload; system processes are listed but never stopped from here.
cw_procs_truncated: The list was cut short: some processes are not shown.
cw_reload_body: Reload this page to carry on.
cw_settings_controls_note: What each controller button does here. Press a button to test it.
cw_settings_err_save: Could not save the setting. Try again.
cw_settings_err_tile_add: Could not add PS5Upload Minion to the home screen. Try again.
cw_settings_err_tile_remove: Could not remove PS5Upload Minion from the home screen. Try again.
cw_settings_fullscreen_note: Hides the browser's bars so the page fills the TV. Takes effect on your next button press.
cw_settings_lan: Allow other devices on the network
cw_settings_lan_off_note: Turning this off disconnects other devices; this console keeps access.
cw_settings_lan_warning: Anyone on your network can then use this page and manage your files.
cw_settings_tile: Show PS5Upload Minion on the home screen
cw_settings_tile_hidden: The PS5 kept its record of PS5Upload Minion, so its home-screen icon is hidden instead.
cw_tour1_cheats: Cheats: switch cheats for the running game.
cw_tour1_fan: Fan: temperatures and how early the fan spins up.
cw_tour1_files: Files: browse, copy, move and delete on the PS5's drives.
cw_tour1_games: Games: start, close, hide or uninstall your games.
cw_tour1_home: Home: the running game, tasks and drives.
cw_tour1_processes: Processes: what runs now; stop a game or a payload.
cw_tour1_settings: Settings: theme, language, full screen and these tips.
cw_tour2_more: Everything else has a button on screen: highlight it and press ✕. Help, at the bottom left, shows which other buttons work.
cw_tour3_fullscreen: The page fills the TV after your first press. You can switch full screen off in Settings.
cw_tour3_pointer: Move the pointer with the left stick: what it is over is highlighted, and ✕ clicks it.
cw_update_ready: PS5Upload Minion was updated. Reload to use the new version.
